description: This file is a PHP class definition for an OpenCart admin controller handling the 'Information' module extension. It includes methods for displaying and saving module configuration details, including UI navigation breadcrumbs and permission checks.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for the 'Information' module extension in OpenCart admin panel, managing display and save operations.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the module configuration page, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the module configuration settings, including permission checks and JSON response for success or error.
